Subject: [URGENT] Production errors and latency spikes - Bluemoon platform

Aisha,

We started seeing a sustained spike in 5xx errors and p95 token latency across our inference calls to the Redwood hosted endpoint starting ~07:45 PST. Error rate climbed from baseline ~0.3% to ~6% and p95 latency jumped from 220ms to 1.8s. This is impacting customer-facing flows (payment verification and user chat).

Quick facts:
- First observed: 2027-02-21 07:45 PST
- Affected region: us-west-2
- Error examples attached (error-samples.log), monitoring screenshot attached (dashboard-screenshot.png)

We've opened an incident on our side but need Redwood engineering on a bridge now. Our ops team is preparing a short triage packet; can you confirm an on-call and a point of contact? We also need an executive readout within the hour if this will be a multi-hour outage.

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Head of Infrastructure, BlueMoon AI

Date: 2027-02-21T08:27:00-08:00
Subject: Re: [URGENT] Production errors and latency spikes - Bluemoon platform

On the bridge — initial triage notes:
- Symptom: high 5xx error rate correlated with a rolling model variant rollout that started at 07:30 PST.
- Root cause hypothesis (early): KV cache invalidation + cold KV cache priming during variant switch caused request latencies to spike; backend autoscaler hit transient limits leading to queueing and occasional 503s.
- Evidence: request traces attached show increased model init and cache-miss times; see attached patch-diff.txt for proposed fix (small change to rolling update to pre-warm KV cache).

Mitigation actions taken (08:25–08:40):
1) Temporarily halted rollout and reverted to previous stable model variant (complete at 08:33).
2) Increased sidecar cache warm threads for customer pools for next 2 hours.
3) Enabled temporary routing to dedicated capacity pool for Bluemoon traffic to reduce shared-queue contention.

Next steps (owners):
- Karthik: postmortem write-up and patch to rolling update behavior (ETA 48h).
- Aisha/Marissa: coordinate exec readout & customer comms (ETA 2h).
- Grace: follow up on SLA credit request path and billing downstream.

--
Karthik Iyer
SRE, Redwood Inference

Attachments: patch-diff.txt

Team — drafting a short executive summary to share with Bluemoon leadership and our execs. Key points below; please review and sign off so I can send by 12:00 PST.

Executive summary (for email):
- What happened: a rollout induced cache warm/miss storm leading to elevated p95 latency and a 45-minute window of customer impact.
- Impact: Bluemoon reported up to 6% 5xx rate and p95 latency spiking to 1.8s for impacted endpoints.
- Immediate action: rollback to stable model variant, temporary routing to reserved capacity, cache warm thread increase.
- Fix plan & ETA: deployment guardrail change (pre-warm KV cache and serialized handoff) — development complete by 2027-02-23, canary deployment 2027-02-24–25, full rollout 2027-02-26.
- Compensation proposal: 10% credit for the affected billing window (proportional).

Asks to leadership:
1) Approve the compensation offer (10% window credit).
2) Approve committing a dedicated weekly governance checkpoint with BlueMoon for 30 days covering rollouts and canaries.

I'll include the related timeline and owners in the email. If I don't hear objections by 11:45 PST I'll send.

Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success

- Performed canary period 2027-02-24–25; no regressions observed.
